Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE II OF 1997
ORDINANCE II OF 1997
NORTH‑WEST FRONTIER
PROVINCE ESTABLISHMENT OF
DISTRICT DEVELOPMENT ADVISORY
COMMITTEES (REPEAL)
ORDINANCE, 1997
An Ordinance further to repeal
the North‑West Frontier Province Establishment of District Development
Advisory Committees Act, 1989
[Gazette of N.‑W.F.P.,
Extraordinary, 27th January, 1997]
No Legis. 1(1)/86/565, dated 27‑1‑1997.‑‑‑The
following Ordinance by the Governor of the North‑West Frontier Province
is hereby published for general information:‑‑
Whereas it is expedient further
to repeal the (North‑West Frontier Province Establishment of District
Development Advisory Committees Act, 1989 (N.‑W. F. P. Act No. IV of
1989);
And whereas the Provincial
Assembly is not in session and the Governor of the North‑West Frontier
Province is satisfied that circumstances exist which render it necessary to
take immediate action;
Now, therefore, in exercise of
the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the North‑West Frontier
Province is pleased to make and promulgate the following Ordinance:‑‑
1. Short title and
commencement.‑‑(1) This Ordinance may be called the North‑West
Frontier Province Establishment of District Development Advisory Committees (Repeal)
Ordinance, 1997.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Whereas it is expedient further

And whereas the Provincial

the powers conferred by clause (1) of Article 128 of the Constitution of the
Islamic Republic of Pakistan, the Governor of the North‑West Frontier

3. Savings.‑‑(1)
Notwithstanding the repeal of the North‑West Frontier Province
Establishment of District Development Advisory Committees Act, 1989 (N.‑W.F.P.
Act No.IV of 1989), any scheme prepared or executed, contract entered into,
suit instituted, right acquired, claims made, legal ' or administrative
proceedings or action taken under the repealed Act shall be deemed to have been
validly prepared or executed, entered into, instituted, acquired, made or
taken.
(2) The assets and liabilities,
if any, acquired under the repealed Act shall henceforth be the assets and
liabilities of the Local Government and Rural Development Department.
